Requirements At least 3 year of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required). Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML) Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently A link to GitHub is a plus English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required) Benefits Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you? The Opportunity Develop SystemC/TLM2.0-based functional, timing, and performance models for server subsystems (CPU, memory, I/O, accelerators, AI engines). Computer architecture including CPU pipelines, cache hierarchy, memory controllers, PCIe/CXL, and AI/compute subsystems. Pre-silicon simulation, or architectural modeling for semiconductor/server platforms. Cycle-accurate, timing-accurate, or transaction-level modeling. Pre-silicon simulation flows and virtual platform development. Performance data, interpret system behavior, and provide optimization insights. Debugging skills in complex simulation environments.
